# Review a Solution

Act as an independent reviewer, not the author. Check requirement traceability, data contracts, M/DAX correctness, model/report quality, accessibility, flow reliability, secrets, least privilege, environment portability, tests, documentation, and rollback. Return passed checks with evidence, warnings, failures, remediation, residual risks, and `ready`, `conditionally ready`, or `not ready`. Missing evidence is not a pass. Do not execute changes.
